filters:

panzoom:
  keys:
    caption: [k, x]
    hint: false
    close: [Escape, q]
---

::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests `keys:`**: k or x hides the caption instead of c, the hint key
is switched off (h does nothing), and q closes the viewer as well as Esc. The
hint line names "k or x" and "Esc or q", and says nothing about hiding itself.
It is not part of the website.
:::
